notes: 1. Vacancy in Georgia's Class 2 seat owing to neither candidate achieving 50 percent of the vote in the November 3, 2020, general election. Both Independent senators caucused with the Democrats.

2. Following runoff elections on January 5, 2021, for both the general (Class 2) and special (Class 3) elections in Georgia, Jon Ossoff (D) was seated, filling the Class 2 vacancy, and Raphael Warnock (D) was seated, replacing appointed Senator Kelly Loeffler (R). With both Independents caucusing with the Democrats and the tie-breaking vote held by Democratic Vice President Kamala Harris, Democrats gained the majority.
